requirement:
Create a small Go module using only the standard library. Use exactly this go.mod:
module example.com/task

go 1.22

Put the implementation in `lib/uniq.go` (package `lib`) and your own tests in `lib/uniq_test.go` (package `lib`, `go test`). No third-party modules.

SPEC: Implement `func Uniq(xs []int) []int`. Remove duplicates, keeping the first occurrence of each value and the original order. An empty input returns an empty (non-nil) slice.
acceptance_criteria: func Uniq(xs []int) []int: Remove duplicates, keeping the first occurrence of each value and the original order. An empty input returns an empty (non-nil) slice.
